implementation.passwords: scrypt with per-password random salt; verification is timing-safe
implementation.sessions: random opaque token stored only as SHA-256 digest; HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; 30-day expiry
implementation.registration: bootstrap invite is hashed and atomically consumed; registration claims the lowest unbound legacy profile or creates a new profile
implementation.compatibility: AUTH_REQUIRED=false preserves local development fallback; AUTH_REQUIRED=true enables account-session gating

http_runtime_smoke.database: temporary copy of migrated database; removed after verification
http_runtime_smoke.register: 201; returned authenticated user and session cookie
http_runtime_smoke.login: 200; returned the same user and rotated session

security_notes: Raw passwords and session tokens are not persisted.
Invalid/expired sessions are rejected and expired rows are deleted.
Invite usage is bounded by an atomic update inside the registration transaction.
The existing local database was migrated in place without changing existing business row counts.
commit_action: one independent commit containing the S1 runtime implementation and evidence
